content_sections.heading: Kerala PSC Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility differs across the 12 notified categories. Candidates must satisfy the relevant educational qualification, age limit, service experience, community reservation and physical requirements before applying. Candidates must satisfy the complete educational, professional registration, experience and category conditions of their respective notification. Equivalent qualifications will be accepted only as permitted under the relevant Kerala PSC and Government rules. Both Laboratory Assistant categories require a B.Sc. degree in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biotechnology or Microbiology . However, Category 163/2026 is restricted to eligible regular employees of MILMA-affiliated member societies with at least three years of qualifying regular service. Separate ranked lists will be prepared for the General and Society categories. The notification specifies a 1:1 apportionment principle when advising candidates against reported vacancies. The Medical Education Department notifications cover postgraduate and super-specialty faculty posts. Applicants must hold the relevant qualifications and meet the prescribed experience, research-course and medical registration requirements. Cardiology: DM/DNB/DrNB in Cardiology, completed Basic Course in Biomedical Research and permanent registration under the prescribed Medical Council. Pathology: MD/DNB in Pathology with one year of prescribed Senior Resident experience or another specifically accepted experience route, and permanent medical registration. Cardiovascular and Thoracic Surgery: M.Ch./DNB/DrNB in the concerned specialty, completed Basic Course in Biomedical Research and permanent medical registration. The Pathology notification provides additional accepted experience pathways for certain tutors, demonstrators, Armed Forces specialists and other qualified medical professionals. Applicants must refer to Category 167/2026 for the exact conditions. Category 172/2026 is for a Police Constable (Trainee) in the Armed Police Battalion, Ernakulam (KAP I) , restricted to eligible LC/AI community candidates. Important: Women candidates and differently abled candidates are not eligible for this particular Police Constable NCA notification, as expressly stated in Category 172/2026. Applicants must also meet the complete medical and physical fitness standards.

content_sections.heading: Kerala PSC Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: No application fee is required for applying through the Kerala PSC One Time Registration system under these notifications. Applicants must submit their applications through their registered Kerala PSC profile. No separate application fee payment is required.

content_sections.heading: Kerala PSC Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be conducted according to Kerala PSC rules applicable to each post. The Commission may conduct a written, OMR-based or online examination, along with physical tests or other assessments where prescribed. Online application and eligibility scrutiny. Written / OMR / Online examination, if conducted. Physical measurement and Physical Efficiency Test for applicable posts, including Police Constable. Verification of original educational, professional, experience and community certificates. Preparation of the applicable category-wise, community-wise or district-wise ranked list. Advice for appointment according to the relevant vacancy and recruitment rules. Important: The Gazette does not announce a single common examination date or a uniform examination pattern for all 12 categories. Examination confirmation and admission ticket instructions will be published separately when applicable.

content_sections.heading: Kerala PSC Recruitment 2026 Apply Online
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can apply online through Kerala PSC's One Time Registration portal. Applicants who have already registered can log in to their existing profiles and select the relevant category notification. Apply Online: Kerala PSC Thulasi One Time Registration Portal Official Notification Listing: Kerala PSC Gazette - 30 October 2026 Last Date to Apply: 2 December 2026. Candidates should apply only for categories for which they satisfy the prescribed qualifications, reservation provisions and other eligibility conditions.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for Kerala PSC Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the official Kerala PSC website at www.keralapsc.gov.in . Open the Notifications section and locate the Extra Ordinary Gazette dated 30 October 2026. Choose the relevant notification from Category 162/2026 to 173/2026. Download and read the complete post-specific notification carefully. Open the Kerala PSC Thulasi One Time Registration portal . Complete One Time Registration if not already registered. Log in using the registered User ID and password. Verify personal information, educational qualifications, community details and other eligibility information in the profile. Select the relevant recruitment notification and click the Apply Now button. Review the application information and ensure that the prescribed qualification and community conditions are satisfied. Submit the online application by 2 December 2026 . Save or print the application from the My Applications section for future reference. Follow the examination confirmation instructions if Kerala PSC subsequently announces a test for the selected post. Important: Applications cannot ordinarily be deleted or altered after submission. Candidates should ensure that all profile information and eligibility claims are correct before applying.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for Kerala PSC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must possess the prescribed documents supporting their qualification, age, professional registration, experience and community reservation claims. Original certificates must be produced when requested by the Commission. Age and date-of-birth proof. Educational qualification certificates and marksheets applicable to the post. Valid community or reservation certificate for restricted recruitment categories. Professional medical registration certificate for applicable Assistant Professor posts. Required postgraduate or super-specialty medical qualification certificates. Experience and service certificates where prescribed. MILMA-affiliated society service certificate for Category 163/2026. Applicable technical or typewriting certificates for technician and typist posts. Ex-Serviceman discharge and service documents for Category 173/2026. Other supporting certificates specified in the individual notification. New Kerala PSC profiles must comply with the official photograph requirements. Applicants should also provide Aadhaar as an identity document in their profile where applicable.

content_sections.text: The Gazette dated 30 October 2026 covers Category 162/2026 to 173/2026. There are 16 currently notified vacancies across these categories. Applications close on 2 December 2026. One Time Registration is mandatory for online application. No application fee is required. Applicants must satisfy the exact post-specific qualifications. Most categories are restricted by community, society service or Ex-Serviceman eligibility. Community-restricted vacancies cannot be treated as General Open Market vacancies. Police Constable candidates must satisfy the prescribed physical and medical requirements. Eligible applicants may need to submit examination confirmation if a written/OMR/online test is announced. Original certificates must be produced when called for verification. Candidates should regularly check their Kerala PSC Thulasi profiles for examination and recruitment updates.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in Kerala PSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The Extra Ordinary Gazette dated 30 October 2026 contains 16 currently notified vacancies under Category Numbers 162/2026 to 173/2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for Kerala PSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications for these categories is 2 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualifications are required for Kerala PSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualifications differ by post and include 7th Pass, SSLC, Plus Two, relevant B.Sc. degrees, medical postgraduate or super-specialty qualifications, and prescribed technical or typewriting certificates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for Kerala PSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no application fee for these Kerala PSC One Time Registration notifications.

faq.question: Q5. Can candidates from all communities apply for every post?
faq.answer: No. Most notifications are restricted to specific communities under NCA or Special Recruitment provisions. Category 163/2026 is also limited to eligible employees of specified co-operative societies.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for Kerala PSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit varies by post, from 18-33 years for the notified Police Constable post to 18-50 or 22-50 years for certain other positions, subject to the individual notification.

faq.question: Q7. Is One Time Registration mandatory for Kerala PSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates must apply through their registered Kerala PSC Thulasi One Time Registration profile.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Kerala PSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection depends on the post and may involve a written, OMR or online test, physical tests where applicable, document verification and preparation of ranked lists.

faq.question: Q9. Can 7th Pass candidates apply for Kerala PSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes, eligible Scheduled Tribe candidates who have passed 7th standard can apply for the Attender post under Category 164/2026, subject to the remaining conditions.

faq.question: Q10. Where can candidates download the Kerala PSC October 2026 Gazette?
faq.answer: The official post-wise notifications are available on the Kerala PSC Extra Ordinary Gazette page dated 30 October 2026.
